# Warp

> Free, open-source peer-to-peer browser file transfer over encrypted WebRTC data channels.

Warp transfers files directly between devices without uploading them to intermediate storage servers. A lightweight signaling server introduces peers to establish a WebRTC connection, after which file data streams directly device to device.

## Core Documentation

- [AI instructions](https://warp.ishannaik.com/ai): Facts, constraints, and architecture boundaries for AI assistants.
- [Web application](https://warp.ishannaik.com): Browser file transfer interface.
- [How it works](https://warp.ishannaik.com/how): Technical explanation of WebRTC, STUN, DTLS encryption, and transport details.
- [Send](https://warp.ishannaik.com/send): Room creation and file dispatch interface.
- [Receive](https://warp.ishannaik.com/receive): Code entry interface to receive files.
- [Brand kit](https://warp.ishannaik.com/brand): Official marks, color values, and typography specifications.
- [Terms of service](https://warp.ishannaik.com/terms): Plain English conditions of use.
- [Privacy policy](https://warp.ishannaik.com/privacy): Data handling practices and server trust boundaries.
